_readme: Shop catalogue. Prices are in pence (1299 = £12.99). Replace these placeholder products with your real stock. 'image' is optional: put the photo in shop/assets/products/ and set e.g. "assets/products/mop.jpg". 'featured': true shows the product under Best sellers on the home page. Set 'stock' to 0 to show 'Sold out'. Add 'compareAt' (the old price) to show the item as on offer.
